AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JANUARY 17, 2017

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  January 17, 2017
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL (6:30 PM)

Present: Thomas, Evans, Welch, Kao & Lazzaro
Absent: None
Also Present: Deputy City Manager/Building & Planning Director Repp-Loadsman,
Planner Corpuz, Assistant City Attorney Kettles

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

CONSENT ITEMS – #2, 3 & 4

1.  Planning Commission Resolution No. 2016-0980; Confirming the Planning
  Commission’s approval, in part, and denial, in part, of M-1131-16; Consideration of a
  Miscellaneous Application for encroachments in the City Parklands at the single family
  residence located at 1445 Via Coronel. Lot 7, Tract 30905. This project is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Cyrus & Jessica Irani

Recommended to be continued to the January 25, 2017 Planning Commission meeting.

Planning Commission  1  Director SR-L
Action Memo
January 17, 2017
 2.  Planning Commission Resolution No. 2016-0981; Confirming the Planning
  Commission’s denial of M-1160-16; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for an
  after-the-fact approval for fencing exceeding the allowable height within the setback
  adjacent to the street at the single family residence located at 273 Rocky Point Road.
  Lot 9, Tract 17606. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Souzan Ardalan

Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Kao seconded to approve
Resolution No. 2016-0981 (5-0 in favor).

3.  M-1161-16; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for non-standard
  encroachments within the City right-of-way at the single family residence located at 2753
  Palos Verdes Drive North. Lot 57, Block 1703, Tract 6882. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Steve & Karen Mitchell

Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Kao seconded to approve the
application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
1) A license agreement shall be submitted to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the city,
its officers, agents and employees from and against any and all loss, damage, liability,
claims, demands, costs, charges, and expenses, including attorney’s fees, and causes of
action of whatsoever character which the City may incur, sustain or be subjected to on
account of loss or damage to property or loss of use thereof, or for bodily injury to or death
of any person arising out of or in any way connected to the encroachment; 2) A license
agreement shall be submitted to reimburse the City for any costs incurred by the City to
repair damage, restore premises, or satisfy claims incurred by reason of the encroachment;
3) The non-standard encroachments (i.e. steps) shall not be located within the first 6-feet
behind the curb; 4) The proposed driveway replacement shall comply with the Public
Works Standards; and 5) The non-standard concrete slabs and sidewalk shall be removed.

Planning Commission  2  Director SR-L
Action Memo
January 17, 2017
 OLD BUSINESS

4.  Request to appeal the Director’s determination of a Minor Modification application for
  NC-1508/G-1535/M-987-14; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous
  Applications for a new single family residence located at 978 Paseo La Cresta. Lot 4,
  Tract 31329. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative
  Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Appellant:  Mark & Kendra Panfil
  974 Paseo La Cresta
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Applicant:  Marsha S. Scully & Associates, Inc.
  4555 Comber Ave.
  Encino, CA 91316
  Owner:  Lowell & Lisa Hill
  1108 Via Mirabel
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Speakers: Mark Panfil, Charles Simonetti, Marsha Scully, Lowell Hill, Marlene Breene
Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Kao seconded to approve the
application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional condition:
Vegetation and landscaping shall be no higher than 2 ft. above the top of the proposed
privacy walls. The approval resolution will be prepared and brought back to the Planning
Commission for adoption on January 25, 2017.

5.  NC-1561/G-1574/M-1100-16; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 936 Via Del
  Monte. Lot 11, Block 1634, Tract 7142. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  PCH / Carlo Calabia
  17800 Castleton St. #406
  City of Industry, CA 91748
  Owner:  Grandway USDev I-C, LLC
  55 South Lake Ave. #600
  Pasadena, CA 91101

Speakers: Carlo Calabia, Jim Nazemi, Everdina Emler, Paul Lee
Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded to approve the
applications (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional
conditions: 1) Portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the
project shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth
in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; 2) The proposed walkway extends across the
driveway top of “x”. A minimum separation of 1 foot from the walkway to the driveway
top of “x” shall be provided; and 3) The driveway shall be reconstructed per City
Standard.

Planning Commission  3  Director SR-L
Action Memo
January 17, 2017
 6.  NC-1570/G-1589/M-1149-16; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 101 Via Colusa.
  Lot 21, Block 1801, Tract 6883. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Douglas J. Leach, Architect
  119 W. Torrance Blvd. # 24
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Aaron & Ashley Pedersen

Speakers: Douglas Leach, Aaron Pederson, Tom Wheeler, Jill Wheeler, Ro Pinto, Todd Wanke,
Joe Sojka
Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Kao seconded to approve the
application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions:
1) All non-standard encroachments shall be removed including, but not limited to, the low
wall along the Via La Selva frontage and stepping stones, within the City right-of-way; 2)
Payment to the tree bank shall be submitted for the removal of the street tree; 3) The
existing curb on Via Colusa and Via La Selva frontages shall be removed and
reconstructed per City Standard. Curb on Via La Selva shall consist of the Valmonte PV
stone curb standard plan ST-29; and 4) The maximum ridge height shall be reduced by 2
ft. to an elevation of 325.

7.  NC-1541R/G-1559R-16; Consideration of Revised Neighborhood Compatibility &
  Revised Grading Applications for a new pool, deck & rear yard improvements at the
  single family residence located at 2812 Victoria Place. Lot 16, Block 2450, Tract 7332.
  This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Rosa Velazquez
  118 S. Catalina Ave. #N
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Ebrahim Soltani

Speakers: Rosa Velazquez, Ebrahim Soltani, Bizhan Khaleeli, Harold Jesse, Jeanne and Fikret
Atamdede
Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded to approve the
application (4-1 in favor, Kao dissenting) with standard conditions.

Planning Commission  4  Director SR-L
Action Memo
January 17, 2017
 NEW BUSINESS

8.  Concept review for Southern California Gas Company Advanced Meter project location
  Site ID MHx5262-B: On the east side of Palos Verdes Drive West at the City of Palos
  Verdes Estates and City of Torrance boundary line north of Via Anita - Received &
  filed.

Speakers: Faviola Ochoa and Derek Sampson from SoCalGas

  lot with frontage on two streets at the single family residence located at 1412 Lower

  Applicant:  Russ Barto
  3 Malaga Cove Plaza #202
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner:  Don & Martha Tuffli

Speakers: Russ Barto
Action: Chair Thomas moved and Commissioner Welch seconded to approve the
application (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional condition:
1) The property owners shall relinquish any rights for vehicular access from Via
Fernandez.

  Applicant:  Cauthen Design Inc.

  Owner:Peter Frederiksen
  616 Via Del Monte

Speakers: Ben Cauthen, Donald Dawson, Vijay Shah

Recommended to be continued to the February 21, 2017 Planning Commission meeting.

Action Memo

 11.  NC-1581/G-1587/M-1157-16; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &

  Anacapa. Lot 7, Block 2218, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant

  Applicant:  Obelisk Architects
  3800 Pacific Coast Hwy.
  Torrance, CA 90505
  Owner:Mr. & Mrs. Johnson

Speakers: Nagy Bakhoum, Louis and Sally Varricchione, Marlene Breene, Pat and Kristy
Gradoville, Lynne LaFleur, Sally Young

Recommended to be continued to the February 21, 2017 Planning Commission meeting.

12.  NC-1151R-16; Consideration of a Revised Neighborhood Compatibility Application for

Action: Commissioner Kao moved and Commissioner Welch seconded to approve the

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMISSION/STAFF

Action: Chair Thomas moved and Commissioner Lazzaro seconded (5-0 in favor) to allow

15.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule - Received & filed.

January 17, 2017
 ACTION MINUTES

16.  Meeting of December 20, 2016.

Action: Chair Thomas moved and Commissioner Welch seconded to approve the minutes
